CA.rationale: Identified content (red coordinates) is explicitly linked to an origin/processing condition for the same referent/time.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), its presentation/organization (origin), and a separate status-like field (blue listing as co-recorded content) are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: An explicit processing/origin condition is attached to the same identified content (red coordinates) and referent/time.

C.rationale: The report explicitly identifies content items (red and blue) with coordinates for the named referent/time.

D.rationale: Content coordinates are reported separately from an explicit origin/status field, distinguishing identification from organization/status.

O.rationale: An origin/represented_time field describes how the content is organized/presented for the given referent/time.
